business_problem: Vodafone Idea needed to embed generative AI across software delivery at scale while maintaining governance, protecting sensitive engineering data under sovereignty requirements, and reducing duplicated effort across more than 150 applications.
solution_summary: Vodafone Idea partnered with IBM Consulting to make IBM Consulting Advantage the operating layer for an AI-first engineering model. ICA was embedded across the software development lifecycle, from business analysis and architecture through development, testing, deployment, and production support, so teams could automate repetitive work and augment decisions instead of adopting isolated AI tools. To satisfy data-sovereignty requirements, the solution uses a hybrid AI architecture: sensitive code and confidential documents are processed through an India-based third-party LLM service, while other use cases can draw on additional foundation models. IBM and Vodafone Idea then created a reusable ecosystem of more than 120 role-based ICA assistants for API design, code generation, testing, deployment validation, and analysis. A GenAI hackathon generated 138 use cases, many of which became enterprise-ready assets, turning AI adoption into a governed engineering platform rather than a pilot.
